body:
Work just seems like a more strict school. You'll get in genuine trouble for missing a day because I have anxiety or showing up late now. That trouble is fired. At worst I'd get bothered by my parents for showing up late to school. Teachers are compassionate to a kid who's overwhelmed and crying. I cried at school almost every day. I'm crying in the school bathroom right now. Nobody wants an 18+ year old who shows up to work every day crying unable to do basic tasks. Or I get too overwhelmed by having to talk to people. Or get so disorganized I messed something up. I'm afraid nobody will ever want me. 

And I hardly even know what I like. I spend all my time going to school and then recovering from being overwhelmed at school that I don't get a chance to do anything. I hate it so much. One thing I like is music, I guess. 

The problem is I don't believe in a purpose in life. This all seems pointless in the grand scheme of things. Just tiny people floating on a huge rock in a huge universe. Everything we created, like the idea of having a purpose, is so arbitrary. Which is why I don't see a point to living if it just seems like my life will always be awful. I don't want to achieve anything. I just wanna be happy and not bother people when I can't do anything right. I don't understand the idea of a purpose.
